title: Assertion Checker
statement: Create a combinational property checker that asserts when a 4-bit value is out of a safe range and holds a fault flag. The module should output an alert signal when the value exceeds 12. This helps verify safety conditions in a datapath.
module_signature: module assertion_checker(input [3:0] value, output reg fault);
behavior: The checker is combinational in behavior.
Purely combinational: outputs must settle after input changes.
Do not depend on initial register values, clocks, or delays.
All outputs must be driven to known 0/1 values for every input case.
constraints: Do not use sequential storage for the quality check.
hint: Implement the condition with simple comparison logic.
